label: No placebo
rationale: This is an interventional PET imaging study where all listed arm groups receive the same tracer [18F]ACI-19626, including healthy controls and participants with suspected TDP-43 proteinopathies. The design describes active/diagnostic comparison between groups and test-retest scanning, not an inactive or sham placebo comparator.

evidence.quote: Both healthy people and people with (suspected) TDP-43 accumulation
Part 3 aims to assess test-retest reliability.

title: [18F]ACI-19626 PET in TDP-43 Proteinopathies

rule.label: No placebo
rule.reason: All recorded arms have recognized non-placebo types and no placebo mention in arms/interventions. Inferred from saved data; sham controls count as no placebo.
